argument.says: What a mount of it is given: one holon, a list of holons, or the field itself; one holon unless it says otherwise.

code.says: The module the interface runs, as JavaScript.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

kinds.says: The kinds of slot it draws in, as full or face.

reads.says: The reads it makes of the field beyond what it is handed, by their forms, as holders or instances: what it may look at, said where it can be seen. None unless it says.

says.says: What it draws, in a sentence.

settings.says: The settings it takes from the slot that opens it, each said in prose with its shape, as a type declares its fields; none unless it says.

source.says: The code as it was written, before it was built.

takes.says: The types whose instances it draws; none means it draws any holon, when nothing closer matches.

body.says: A holon that declares the types it takes and draws what it is given, opening space in it where what it holds is drawn in turn by the components that match.
body.title: Component
